package.name: revhub
package.description: REV Robotics Hub control for a 4-motor holonomic robot. revhub_node owns the hub serial session and subscribes body-velocity motion commands (Twist: forward, sideways, angular) applying hub-firmware velocity PID per wheel; motion_control arbitrates command sources (joystick topic, motion planner) onto cmd_vel. Wheel encoder feedback is published as JointState.
